recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-16340 unless a future work-group decision reopens AdministrativeGender code membership or extension guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-16340 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It originally requested removing AdministrativeGender `other` and adding `Intersex`, but the final work-group decision was to keep `other` and clarify its comments to mean a value other than male/female/unknown, with localized more specific values represented by extension.
initial_application: Jira comments record that Drew Torres updated the definition of Other on 2018-08-08. Git commit f12ba5cfadaa8d8797602dd1aa9faf7a10e7a4f2 changed `source/terminologies/bindings.xml` from the older hermaphrodite-based description to the FHIR-16340 clarification text.
additional_context: The current terminology spreadsheet source and current CodeSystem source both contain the clarified sentence with `specific` spelled correctly. FHIR-18842 is the same-sentence spelling correction and already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no seed-specific discussion that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current core source already preserves the work-group decision to keep `other`, not add `Intersex`, and point implementers to extensions for localized more specific administrative gender values.
